message.name: CorporateActionInstructionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice002V14
message.definition: Scope|The CorporateActionInstructionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice message is sent by an account servicer to an account owner or its designated agent to report the status of a previously received CorporateActionInstructionCancellationRequest message sent by the account owner. This will include the acknowledgement/rejection of a request to cancel an outstanding instruction. |Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: If Code is present, the code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. ||If Code is present, the code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. ||If Code is present, the code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: EventTypeRule
rules.text: EventType/Code OTHR must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate. |EventType/Code CHAN must only be used in case no other corporate action event code is appropriate and only for an event which relates to a change. |EventType/Code REDM must only be used when the redemption is decided by the issuer and not by the securities holders.

rules.name: OfficialCorporateActionEventReference
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the structure and usage of the Official Corporate Action Event Reference (COAF). Those recommendations are|available in the SMPG Global Market Practices Part 1 document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: AccountServicerDeadlineMissedGuideline
rules.text: When ReasonCode/Code is ADEA (Account Servicer Deadline Missed), the instruction is assumed to be processed “on a best effort basis” by the account servicer.

rules.name: AdditionalReasonInforrmationRule
rules.text: The AdditionalReasonInformation element must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When a ISIN code exist. It is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: OptionNumberRule
rules.text: For differentiation between options, the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType must be used, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code. Therefore, the OptionNumber value must be different for each option.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: SafekeepingPlace must only be used by global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.

rules.name: StatusQuantityOrStatusCashAmount1Rule
rules.text: If StatusQuantity is present, then StatusCashAmount is not allowed. (MT 567 C5).

rules.name: StatusQuantityOrStatusCashAmount2Rule
rules.text: If StatusCashAmount is present, then StatusQuantity is not allowed. (MT 567 C5).

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: AdditionalInformationRule
rules.text: All elements in the AdditionalInformation sequence must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field unless bilaterally agreed.

rules.name: BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequestRule
rules.text: If CorporateActionInstruction/OptionType/Code value is BOBD (BeneficialOwnerBreakdownRequest), then CorporateActionGeneralInformation/EventType/Code value must be WTRC (Withholding Tax Relief Certification).|(MT567 NVR C6)
